risk: Future schema versions silently load as mutable schema-4-like profiles
source_evidence: core/progress.py load() migrates 2/3 but does not reject >4; save() is called by award
acceptance: Non-mutating version guard; future schema must not be replaced or downgraded; temp-profile tests including unknown keys

risk: Learner Python runs as local user; worker is not a security sandbox
source_evidence: core/grade.py and core/worker.py use subprocess; OS rights remain
acceptance: Keep isolated local process, strict timeouts/byte limits, data-only worker outputs; warning; do not ingest arbitrary remote code

risk: Rewards or effects can double after replay, retries or interrupted deployment
source_evidence: core/progress.py award() and game/expedition.py persisted jobs
acceptance: Stable event IDs, atomic milestone, replay no award; crash-after-commit and restart tests

risk: Normal expedition travel is blocked by unfinished chapter prerequisites
source_evidence: game/expedition.py travel() and world map requirements; preview bypass
acceptance: Remove unreachable/cyclic prerequisites without changing existing completions; locked/preview/existing checkpoint tests

risk: One new uniform grading adapter could break multiple legacy worker return modes
acceptance: Feature flag; parity tests for script,function,object,rover,expedition; legacy default path

risk: Robot plans may apply after map, robot, program or capability change
acceptance: Hash+revision+state revalidation, bounded action count, no partial mutation for invalid plan

risk: Visual additions may cover level or incorrectly transform mouse coordinates
acceptance: Screenshot matrix, bounding box collision checks, 3 resolutions and input letterbox tests

risk: Static ZIP checks do not prove Windows launcher works after code changes
source_evidence: v1.4 release ZIP static audit; tools/native_smoke.py
acceptance: Actual Windows extraction in a path with spaces, runtime launch, play/save/reopen, screenshots

risk: Large maps, overlays and replay queues may exceed frame and memory budgets
acceptance: Measure actual frame percentiles, startup, memory and stress fixture on target hardware

risk: Synthetic signal and mapping pipelines can silently mis-handle units and missing readings
acceptance: Deterministic fixtures; explicit ms/mV, tie policy, NaN/Inf rejection; missing != zero; isolated mesh vertices

risk: Blueprint mission rows can be miscounted as executable gameplay
acceptance: Count only loaded runtime IDs with exercised executable grader and world effect, plus QA evidence

risk: Hint/reveal scaffolding may reward copying over comprehension
acceptance: Keep legacy 100/75/25 XP; optional transfer questions and independent retries, no extra XP for replay

risk: Work interruption or stale source overwrite could lose v1.4/newer progress
acceptance: Full source zip+SHA256 before edits; atomic CURRENT pointer after verified archive; resume from actual latest source

risk: Biomed world could appear clinical or leak real health data
acceptance: Synthetic-only toy experiments, non-clinical labels, no proprietary code/patient samples

risk: A second overlay-heavy UI pass could regress world readability
acceptance: One Orion benchmark scene then per-world tiles and annotated before/after screenshot matrix

risk: Planning suites passing can be mistaken for playable implementation / release validation
source_evidence: Stage08–12 test logs and Stage10 gates
acceptance: Always separate planning, headless game, native Windows, performance, human testing evidence
